deployments.note: One connection to Coinbase's public market data feed. Records quotes and trades, writes heartbeat.json and serves live.sock to other apps on trade1. Never sends orders.

settings.help: Coinbase product ids, separated by commas

settings.help: Days older than this are removed (0: no age rule)

settings.label: Keep free on disk (GB)
settings.help: The oldest days are also removed when the disk has less free space than this
